candidates.original_title: On using current information to value hard-rock mineral properties
candidates.description: Cairns and Davis (1998) tested and rejected the Hotelling Valuation Principle using cross-sectional data on gold mines
candidates.citation_sentence: A recent study by Cairns and Davis (1998) tested and rejected the Hotelling Valuation Principle (HVP) using cross-sectional data on gold mines.
candidates.notes: The paper presents both OLS results (marginal rejection at 6%) and WLS results (no rejection); authors conclude HVP holds up with WLS, but OLS results could be read as partial support for C&D's finding.
